text:
This is culturally so important to realize: eth as sov is the ambitious and inspiring path for Ethereum too. 

Ethereum as a civilizational root of trust is infinitely more exciting and valuable to the world than the myopic path of optimizing for revenue today, running it like a business, and in the process driving away everything that makes Ethereum special in the first place. 

Bitcoin has the credible neutrality and security but not the architecture to become a root of trust beyond itself. It will be Ethereum or no one. 

We mustn’t forget the scale of our target. Be ambitious.

quoted_tweet.author: Caspar
quoted_tweet.text: The beauty of ETH as store of value is that it’s not giving up on Ethereum the technology. It won’t be a “boring ledger”. In fact ETH is special because Ethereum is special. It is Ethereum that is credibly neutral, secure, and architecturally set up to be the root of trust for the world. And ETH sits right at its center, as the most durable, trustless and useful asset. There only exists a strong  ETH with a flourishing and ambitious Ethereum.

@VitalikButerin Ты, скотина, ты и вся ваша шайка EF — вам больше нет места в этом мире

@VitalikButerin Pricing state creation upfront makes sense, nodes carry that data forever. Curious how much you expect this to raise costs for airdrop-heavy apps and memecoin launchpads that spin up tons of new accounts and storage slots?

It's already been recommended for airdrops to use a merkle tree based approach: the issuer only posts the root, each user provides their branch and pays their own gas to claim.

Longer term, use UTXOs and (for privacy) keyed nonces to store token balances instead of storage slots.

The expectation is that both will be significantly cheaper than storage slots because the more restricted rules of how that state can be accessed allows most nodes to avoid fully storing it.
@YuriSez Дякую за підтримку

@kay_myg Very short run, yes.

Medium run, apps will retool to use more computation and less state (eg. airdrops switching to being merkle tree based), and apps that are exec heavy (eg. privacy protocols) will be bolder in increasing their usage.

Not having a good AI model powering your central home device will be a growing liability. You see the difference when you have a central PC with Codex/Code/OpenClaw and you try to use Siri or Alexa. Frontier models act like the household computer from sci-fi & are more intuitive.

A good frontier model can reason about the state of the house; point out anomalies, safety issues, or things that are wrong; and solve problems for you. They have increasingly good spatial understanding from images. All of this is the things you want.

I was watching the new Apple HomeView reviews and seeing that they hallucinate and fail to understand what's going on around them. Feels very bitter lessonable compared to whatever expert system they're trying to build.

text:
I think often about the fact that almost everyone working in the West has lived in a quite stable socio-technical period

Only 1 job out of 270 in the 1950 census is now obsolete (elevator operator)

2026 is similar to 1957 in a way that 1969 was not from 1900.

That may change.

The image comes from one of my first posts on OneUsefulThing right after the release of ChatGPT, based on the premonition that this time, things are going to be different.

If we avoid disaster, worth remembering humans are very good at muddling through.
https://www.oneusefulthing.org/p/becoming-strange-in-the-long-singularity

But it also means that no leader of a company, government, or any other institution has ever had to deal with a radically different socio-technical regime. The old approaches that worked through the ups-and-downs of the previous 75 years may not work for the years ahead.
@emollick 'if we avoid disaster' is carrying a lot of weight in that sentence.
@rainwaterJay What a terrible prompt. Of course it is.

说件事。

本人 10 月 16 日晚回家途中，突发急性心梗，寡妇血管完全被血栓堵死，强撑到家，胸背痛加剧到无法忍受。紧急赶往医院，到急诊室几分钟后心脏骤停，医护人员当场 CPR 抢救回来，随后推入手术室，清理血栓安装支架。

今天是术后一个月，身体和心脏都恢复都很好。

目前在家静养，勿扰。
还是要提醒大家，换季时容易出现心脑血管意外。遇到突发胸痛切勿自行前往医院，立刻拨打 120，如果自己在家同时把门打开，可以叫物业上门协助，大城市物业都有 AED 。有阿司匹林的话嚼碎吞服一个成人剂量（300毫克），等救护人员上门。不要吃速效救心丸或者硝酸甘油这类药，特别是后者，容易造成血压下降反而恶化病情。响马老师命硬，能再活 100 年没问题 🤣
